## Reader need

Explain the decision or learning task this change improves.

## Evidence

Link to primary documentation. For software, summarize maintenance and release status. For standards or lifecycle changes, include the source and the date checked.

## Checks

- [ ] Read CONTRIBUTING.md and checked for duplicate resources.
- [ ] Verified the description, canonical URL, and relevant limitations.
- [ ] Disclosed affiliation and relevant access or payment requirements.
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/check.py`.
- [ ] Checked changed external links and reviewed redirects or access blocks.
